newsitem.title: INDIA: India approves P&O Australia port investment.
newsitem.headline: India approves P&O Australia port investment.

text.p: India said on Monday the Cabinet Committee on Foreign Investment had approved an investment of 2.85 billion rupees ($80 million) proposed by P&O Australia Ports to build a container terminal near Bombay.

It said in a statement that the committee approved a proposal by P&O for the investment by South Asia Ports Ltd of Mauritius, representing a 95 percent stake in Nhava Sheva International Container Terminal Ltd (NSICT).
The statement gave no other details.
NSICT is developing a new facility at Nhava Sheva port near Bombay.
Earlier this year India awarded the Australian firm a contract to build the terminal under a port privatisation programme.
The government said NSICT would pay P&O Australia an annual fixed fee of $300,000 for management services.
